description: Kompletterande material till Larsson (2025) Från askan: en 150-årsjubileum översyn av Askja-1875 tephra is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Stockholms universitet. Supplementary material to the article "From the ashes: a 150th anniversary review of the Askja-1875 tephra" by S.A. Larsson, published in Dynamica through Stockholm University in 2025 ( The material is published as a.xlsx spreadsheet file containing the following contents, divided onto separate sheets (also made available as separate.csv and.txt files): Table S1. Coverage: Stockholms universitet. The portal shows the English title as "Supplementary Material for Larsson (2025) From the ashes: a 150th anniversary review of the Askja-1875 tephra" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Stockholms universitet. Its keywords include Quaternary environments, Geochemistry not elsewhere classified, Geochronology. The listing shows 2025-07-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
